_comment: The fixed sentences of the Practice sessions (Set A and Set B). Six one-group 2-3-1 sentences: Set A is a statement, a wh-question and a command; Set B is a statement, a statement and a wh-question. The peak sits on the last important word of each sentence (the word the sentence answers for).

sentences.text: I left my keys at home.
Where did you put the book?
His brother is a bus driver.
